'''Menise''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[free-trader]]s from [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]]. By [[3 BBY/Legends|3 BBY]], she often visited [[Kabaira]] where she played [[Sabacc/Legends|sabacc]] with her friends [[Tere Metallo]], [[Branak]], [[Treimar]] and [[Del Hunter]] in [[Drayhar's Cantina]].<ref name="Passages" />
